_doc: Floors (generation only grows): generative_share, planes, trigger_share.
Recorded context, asserted by nothing: observed_fires, recover_s.
Loosening a bound is a deliberate, reviewable diff line, not a refactor's side effect.
planes floors Coverage.planes generated-per-plane, so a gain in one plane can no
longer mask a loss in another; the key set is exact, because which planes exist is
fixed by the tune's emits rather than by how well they are recovered.
observed_fires is context, not a ceiling: a RAW-replayed byte carries no trigger and a
generated one needs one, so converting residual into generation RAISES it wherever the
new trigger is an EDGE -- measured against the in-flight pulse sweep at 2400 frames,
residual 3792 -> 1158 while observed fires rose 12932 -> 13590. A ceiling there
penalises the progress this file exists to demand. trigger_share (Coverage.triggers,
generated/all) is the floor that replaces it: 0.0 wherever nothing is generated, and
it cannot be gamed by generating less.

baseline.jitter: none: every figure below reproduced exactly on two independent runs, so the bounds sit at the measured value with no margin

tunes.frames_why: 400 is where each structure recurs rather than happening once: orderlist cursor $54EC takes 3 values (2 advances), pattern cursor $54EF resets twice, and the $10 pulse ramp runs segments of up to 24 emits at step 22 over bound 256 (2 full turns). At 200 each of the three occurs exactly once; the full tune's 11750 frames is ~236s and far too slow for CI

the 400-frame entry cannot see the pulse-width sweep at all: Commando's turning instruments enter around frame 800, so pw holds 407/485 = 84% at 400 and 708/844 = 84% at 700, then knees to 600/1008 = 60% at 800 and 900/2115 = 43% here, where pw's 1215 residual is 91% of the tune's whole 1337. Sweeping 400..11750 (pw bottoms at 8492/31563 = 27%, residual 23071 of 25763, ~236s), 1200 is the smallest count that registers work of this size: against the in-flight pulse sweep it moves pw 900 -> 1569 and residual 1337 -> 668, where 400 moves neither by a single emit and 800 moves pw by 2. Costs 2.6s to recover, against ~76s at 7200

a second engine at the same frame count; mid-range share, so movement in either direction is visible where Commando's 0.92 has little room left. It carries no pw plane at all -- its 1170 residual is mostly filter 0/802 -- so it locks the planes Commando's entries cannot
